Nature & food

skunk noun

modern

Traupman 380

viverra pūtida

skunk, the “stinking ferret”

Traupman’s phrase: viverra is Pliny’s ferret, pūtidus stinking (Cicero).

Other words

  • mustēla pūtōria

    avoid · modern · Andresian p. 25

    Andresian’s name for the skunk, but Mustela putorius is the zoologists’ name of the European polecat, another animal. pūtōrius is not in Lewis & Short; its quantities follow pūtor, stench.

See also weasel.

SourcesLewis & Short: viverra · Lewis & Short: putidus · Lewis & Short: mustela · Lewis & Short: putor
